name: CRIVIT
verdict: The CRIVIT sports brand's website is operated by Lidl Stiftung & Co. KG (Schwarz Group). Nothing found.
note: Sports-apparel and equipment brand sold through Lidl; its website imprint names Lidl Stiftung & Co. KG as site operator. Lidl-Trek partner from the 2026 kit (sleeve) and namesake of the CRIVIT Performance Center, Bad Wimpfen. Rated none via the Lidl - Schwarz Group - Dieter Schwarz chain.
